draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 37th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 5th of 37 at CB. He went 42nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jackrabbit Jenkins. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2021, 18th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 30 career games and 4 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2024.
